effects: The signer agrees that Ledger's wallet may mint one Ledger Quest (LQ) NFT to `receiver`. The contract only accepts the signature when `receiver` is the signer.
The token id is built as categoryId*10^10 + collectionId*10^6 + a running counter. The NFT goes to `receiver` through `_mint`.
The signer pays nothing: no token or native currency leaves, and Ledger's wallet pays the gas.
The signature has no nonce and no deadline. Ledger's wallet can reuse it to mint another NFT of the same collection if the signer no longer holds one.
formats.shown: The screen reads "Mint" from Ledger and shows the receiver address and two raw numbers, Quest Type and Collection.

findings.title: mint: the intent "Mint" does not say that a free Ledger Quest NFT is minted to the receiver.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json "intent": "Mint". LedgerQuest.sol mint(): `_mint(receiver, tokenId);`. The ERC721 name is "Ledger Quest" and the symbol is "LQ" (meta.json constructorArguments).
findings.fix: Use intent "Mint Ledger Quest NFT" and interpolatedIntent "Mint Ledger Quest NFT (collection {collectionId}) to {receiver}".

findings.title: mint: Quest Type and Collection appear as raw ids, and their names exist only off chain.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json fields categoryId and collectionId use "format": "raw". LedgerQuest.sol holds no names for categories or collections, only `pausedCollections` and `tokensInCollection`.
findings.fix: None is possible on chain. An enum works only if the categories are fixed.

findings.title: mint: the signature has no nonce or deadline, so Ledger's wallet can reuse it to mint again later.
findings.evidence: LedgerQuest.sol mint() hashes only `receiver, categoryId, collectionId`. The duplicate check is only `if(ownedTokenCollectionId == collectionId) revert` on the tokens the receiver holds now.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can fix this. It only gives the signer extra NFTs, and none of the signer's assets leave.

cases.notes: Synthetic case with no mined tx, judged from the code. The single effect is the receiver (the signer) getting one LQ NFT, and the screen shows that receiver. The EIP-712 domain name "Ledger Quest" and version "1" match the constructor arguments.
